standard_prerequisites.name: Nisan pairwise-independent hash mixing and hybrid-generator bound; canonicalizer specialization of Putterman-Pyne

core_obligations: Compose partial reversible catalytic machines while reusing their catalytic tape.
Shift and round approximate matrix powers to enforce tape-independent outputs.
Recursively power matrices with one shared catalytic tape and specialize the parameters to the BPL tradeoff.
difficulty_reason: Combines conditional compression with a partial reversible-machine composition theorem and randomized shift-and-round operations that enforce unique outputs across all catalytic tapes. The complete single-stage rounding argument, recursive composition proof and general parameter tradeoff are retained; the fixed logarithmic-workspace endpoint is not counted again.

dedup.scope: Root exclusive-source allocation checked complete legacy, aliases, preparation and both active lines with zero neighbors. This item is the general recursive resource tradeoff; GA010 is the fixed logarithmic-workspace numerical powering algorithm, and GA009 is mutual ROBP search. The general tradeoff has the additional partial-machine composition and shifted-rounding recursion; the endpoint is not separately counted within this task.
